images.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic still life, overhead top-down shot, chiaroscuro lighting. A finished steel sword resting diagonally on a grey sharpening whetstone on a dark scarred wooden workbench, a few glowing embers and metal filings around it, single hard light raking across the razor edge. Absolutely no people, no hands, no figures. No text. Vertical frame, upper third dark.
